definitions.explanation: Any condition affecting the heart, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{心臓病|しんぞうびょう}で{入院|にゅういん}している。
examples.english: My grandfather is hospitalized due to heart disease.

examples.japanese: {心臓病|しんぞうびょう}の{予防|よぼう}には{適度|てきど}な{運動|うんどう}が{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: Moderate exercise is effective for preventing heart disease.

examples.japanese: {心臓病|しんぞうびょう}は{日本人|にほんじん}の{死因|しいん}の{上位|じょうい}を{占|し}める。
examples.english: Heart disease ranks among the top causes of death for Japanese people.

notes:
{心臓病|しんぞうびょう} refers to heart disease in general.

Types of heart disease:
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう} (angina)
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく} (heart attack/myocardial infarction)
- {心不全|しんふぜん} (heart failure)
- {不整脈|ふせいみゃく} (arrhythmia)
- {弁膜症|べんまくしょう} (valvular disease)

Related terms:
- {心臓|しんぞう} (heart)
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか} (arteriosclerosis)
- {心電図|しんでんず} (electrocardiogram/ECG)

Risk factors:
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ} (high blood pressure)
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (diabetes)
- {喫煙|きつえん} (smoking)
- {肥満|ひまん} (obesity)
